steps.prompt: Before the check: which kind of sequence do you handle fastest now, and which one do you still have to stop and think about?

cards.title: Sequences and sums: quick review
cards.body: Arithmetic: term $n$ is $a + (n - 1)d$, terms $= \frac{\text{last} - \text{first}}{d} + 1$, sum $=$ terms $\times$ average. Geometric: term $n$ is $ar^{n - 1}$, $1 + r + \cdots + r^n = \frac{r^{n + 1} - 1}{r - 1}$, forever $= \frac{a}{1 - r}$ when $-1 < r < 1$.

cards.title: Recursion, telescoping, patterns: quick review
cards.body: Recursion: compute the first terms carefully; stairs: $W(n) = W(n - 1) + W(n - 2)$. Telescoping: $\frac{1}{k(k + 1)} = \frac{1}{k} - \frac{1}{k + 1}$, and only the ends survive. Patterns: find the cycle, use the remainder, and remainder $0$ means the last item.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ AMC-style problems with choices, easiest first, no hints. You need all $8$ right (100%) to pass. If you miss one, you'll see the solutions and which skills to review, and the next try gives you new problems.

prompts: Which habit from this unit will you use first on your next test?
Which skill will you keep practising in the daily review?
